findings.label: D9 follows the source order
examples: 1/1 paragraphs follow the source's points in its order (agreement 1.00); fine if each part notices something; check T13 and T09 in the tell ledger
findings.reason: It is Emulate's rewrite (samples cj and ck) of the two sentences it replaces, so it follows their points in order by design; the turns are Emulate's own ("is made up of a collection of", "take the form of", "consciously build").

findings.label: E36/E41 heavy second person
findings.reason: The "you"s are the reader's own history and the inner adult the reader builds ("rules ... that you adopted as a child", "how you were treated", "that you consciously build"): it says what the parent script is; it does not coach.
